scope: Only conditional E10 Fourier ell1/ell3 at one k,z, unit deltaBias Pcb; no physical galaxy xi window, selection sign, data likelihood or sensitivity forecast.

marginal_RR_identifiability_theorem.inference: R(x) alone does not identify eta(x) or the EV intrinsic unconditioned mean; same positive R is consistent with eta=0 and eta!=0; original released tracer-specific randoms are not tagged with latent neutrino-CDM wind sign.
marginal_RR_identifiability_theorem.common_sign_independent_linear_window: A fixed linear operator M applied to symmetric mean T_plus+T_minus=0 returns 0 for the EV intrinsic term; standard even-to-odd leakage is separate.
marginal_RR_identifiability_theorem.generality_limits: Two-state locally uniform wind toy, fixed equal magnitude and paired coordinates. No universal claim for nonlinear galaxy bias, genuine velocity-density correlations, relativistic terms, full survey window, or actual eBOSS odd mean.
marginal_RR_identifiability_theorem.bounded_mean_only_if_fixed_t_F_and_nonne: -abs(t_F)<=eta*t_F<=abs(t_F); this is only a toy conditional-source bound, not a bound on full galaxy EV or systematic terms.

science_decision: Original unweighted eBOSS 24D cannot be assigned a nonzero EV mean from original E10 conditional source and marginal released RR alone. Conditional angular noncollinearity is a theoretical fingerprint only; a genuine external halo/tracer sign response or independently velocity-conditioned estimator must be supplied before physical inference.
